berryglow.config.title: BerryGlow Options
berryglow.config.enableGlowBerryEffect.t: Glow berries give Glowing. Disabling this stops the effect.
berryglow.config.enableGlowingPotions.to: Disabling this stops crafting. Existing potions still work. Requires restarting Minecraft.
berryglow.config.enableGlowingSpectralAr: Allows crafting Spectral Arrows using Lingering Glowing Potions. Disabling this stops the recipe.
